# OpenClaw plugin tools. Generated by packages/openclaw-extension/scripts/interface-listing.mjs; do not edit.
# Run `pnpm interfaces` after changing them. Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
http /plugins/agent-wechat/native | match prefix, auth gateway, scope trusted-operator | -
policy wechat-conference-consultation | trusted tool policy | Recheck the exact conference consultation's current group permission before each tool.
tool wechat_archive_history | optional | Read the locally stored history of any thread in the configured WeChat account, newest first, without sender filtering or read marking. Use wechat_archive_threads to find thread IDs.
tool wechat_archive_history.cursor | string, max length 8192 | Opaque nextCursor from the same tool and query; do not invent one.
tool wechat_archive_history.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | Maximum number of results on this page.
tool wechat_archive_history.threadId | string, required, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact thread ID from wechat_archive_threads.
tool wechat_archive_media | optional, catalog direct-only | Retrieve an attachment or quoted text/image/link from any thread in the configured WeChat account by its message ID. Use the parent quote message ID for quotes. Returns verified managed file paths and an image preview for vision. Cached bytes first; missing media requests a bounded server-owned download unless download=false. Preserve pending/expired/unavailable results and never automatically retry retryable=false. No sends or read marking.
tool wechat_archive_media.download | boolean, default true | Set false to use cached media only without requesting a WeChat transfer.
tool wechat_archive_media.messageId | string, required, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact opaque message ID from an earlier result.
tool wechat_archive_media.quality | string, values best|original|standard|thumbnail|normal|encoded, default best | best uses the best cached image, normal video or decoded voice. Explicit variants are strict and may be unavailable.
tool wechat_archive_message | optional | Look up a stored message in any thread of the configured WeChat account by its exact opaque message ID. Use wechat_archive_media to retrieve its attachment.
tool wechat_archive_message.messageId | string, required, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact opaque message ID from an earlier result.
tool wechat_archive_search | optional | Search locally stored messages across every thread in the configured WeChat account, including other senders. Optional threadId narrows the search. Follow nextCursor with the same query and thread selection; no remote backfill or read marking.
tool wechat_archive_search.cursor | string, max length 8192 | Opaque nextCursor from the same tool and query; do not invent one.
tool wechat_archive_search.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | Maximum number of results on this page.
tool wechat_archive_search.query | string, required, min length 1, max length 256 | Case-insensitive text to find in message text.
tool wechat_archive_search.threadId | string, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact thread ID from wechat_archive_threads.
tool wechat_archive_threads | optional | List or find locally stored threads across the configured WeChat account. Optional case-insensitive query matches thread IDs and display names. Includes groups and peers, with opaque pagination; no read marking.
tool wechat_archive_threads.cursor | string, max length 8192 | Opaque nextCursor from the same tool and query; do not invent one.
tool wechat_archive_threads.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | Maximum number of results on this page.
tool wechat_archive_threads.query | string, min length 1, max length 256 | Case-insensitive text to match against thread IDs and display names.
tool wechat_call | optional, catalog direct-only | Check voice-call status, dial an authorized contact, start or join a configured voice conference, invite allowed contacts to its owned conference, or hang up. Use action hangup when asked to leave the current call; in a conference it removes only this agent, leaving the room open for others. Owner-authorized call consultations can control their call without the separate chat-requester allowlist. Destination and group allowlists, host tool policy and approvals still apply. Join requires a current invitation and never creates a room. Invitations do not promote a direct call. Never retry an uncertain operation without the user's request. Do not claim an action was attempted before executing it.
tool wechat_call.action | string, required, values status|dial|conference_start|conference_join|invite|hangup | Call operation to run; the tool description explains each one.
tool wechat_call.contactId | string, min length 1, max length 200 | Contact to dial. Required for dial.
tool wechat_call.contactIds | array, min items 1, max items 100, unique items | Contacts to invite. Required for conference_start and invite.
tool wechat_call.groupId | string, min length 1, max length 200 | Group of the configured voice conference. Required for conference_start and conference_join.
tool wechat_group_info | enabled by default | Read cached group information and one page of members for the configured WeChat account. Available only to the trusted OpenClaw owner. Does not create groups, invite people or change settings. Cached member absence does not prove non-membership.
tool wechat_group_info.cursor | string, max length 8192 | Opaque nextCursor from the previous wechat_group_info result; do not invent one.
tool wechat_group_info.groupId | string, required, min length 10, max length 256 | Exact ordinary group username ending in @chatroom.
tool wechat_group_info.limit | integer, min 1, max 50 | Maximum number of members on this page.
tool wechat_group_info.username | string, min length 1, max length 256 | Optionally inspect one exact member instead of listing a page.
tool wechat_history | enabled by default | Read the current WeChat conversation's locally stored messages, newest first, beyond the recent inbound buffer. Follow nextCursor for older history; no remote history backfill or read marking.
tool wechat_history.cursor | string, max length 8192 | Opaque nextCursor from the same tool and query; do not invent one.
tool wechat_history.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | Maximum number of results on this page.
tool wechat_login | enabled by default, catalog direct-only | Check WeChat status, start or resume native login, or wait for the same login operation. Show the returned QR image to the user to scan and approve on their phone; do not generate a replacement QR. Repeated start reuses an active operation. For a new operation, force uses QR instead of saved trust. timeoutMs bounds the wait. Disconnect retains saved trust. Logout reports its durable native outcome; it does not promise saved-device revocation. Forget requires confirm=true and removes local authentication while retaining history.
tool wechat_login.action | string, required, values status|start|wait|disconnect|logout|forget | Login step to run; the tool description explains each one.
tool wechat_login.confirm | boolean | Required true for forget.
tool wechat_login.force | boolean | With start, use QR instead of saved trust for a new login. An active login is still reused.
tool wechat_login.timeoutMs | integer, min 1000, max 300000 | Wait bound in milliseconds; defaults to 30000. Start returns as soon as a QR is available.
tool wechat_media | enabled by default, catalog direct-only | Retrieve a message attachment or quoted text/image/link from the current WeChat conversation. Use the parent quote message ID for quotes. Returns a verified local file path and an image preview for vision when applicable. Uses cached bytes first; download defaults to true and requests a bounded server-owned transfer if missing. Pending results may be checked again; never automatically retry confirmed expiry or retryable=false. Does not send messages or mark the thread read.
tool wechat_media.download | boolean, default true | Set false to use cached media only without requesting a WeChat transfer.
tool wechat_media.messageId | string, required, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact opaque message ID from an earlier result.
tool wechat_media.quality | string, values best|original|standard|thumbnail|normal|encoded, default best | best uses the best cached image, normal video or decoded voice. Explicit variants are strict and may be unavailable.
tool wechat_message | enabled by default | Look up a stored message by its exact opaque message ID in the current WeChat conversation. Media is described without downloading it; use wechat_media to retrieve its attachment. Long text is bounded.
tool wechat_message.messageId | string, required, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact opaque message ID from an earlier result.
tool wechat_recall | enabled by default | Recall one own sent message in the current WeChat conversation by its exact opaque message ID from a verified send receipt or wechat_history, or inspect a retained recalled placeholder without another native mutation. The daemon checks eligibility. Returns the durable operation and confirmed, rejected, pending or uncertain result. Never invent IDs or resubmit an uncertain action with a new key; prior model input and completed actions cannot be erased.
tool wechat_recall.messageId | string, required, min length 1, max length 4096 | Exact stored message ID in this conversation; send/job/operation IDs are not message IDs.
tool wechat_recall.serverId | string, required, pattern ^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$ | Exact decimal server ID from the same verified receipt or history entry. The stored local message ID alone may be reused.
tool wechat_search | enabled by default | Search the current WeChat conversation's locally stored message text by case-insensitive substring, beyond buffered messages. Follow nextCursor with the same query in this conversation.
tool wechat_search.cursor | string, max length 8192 | Opaque nextCursor from the same tool and query; do not invent one.
tool wechat_search.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | Maximum number of results on this page.
tool wechat_search.query | string, required, min length 1, max length 256 | Case-insensitive text to find in message text.
tool wechat_search.sender | string, max length 256 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
tool wechat_send_share | enabled by default | Send a URL share card to the current WeChat conversation, with an explicit title, URL, optional description and public thumbnail URL. Does not fetch or summarize the linked page. Use one idempotencyKey per intended share and reuse it after timeouts; never retry an uncertain send with a new key. Returns a durable send ID and state. Accepted means server acceptance; recipient rendering requires verification.
tool wechat_send_share.idempotencyKey | string, required, min length 1, max length 200 | Stable unique key for this logical share. Reuse the same key and identical fields when inspecting/retrying this request.
tool wechat_send_share.thumbnailUrl | string, min length 1, max length 8192 | Public HTTP(S) image URL advertised as the card thumbnail; no upload or page scraping.
tool wechat_send_share.title | string, required, min length 1, max length 16384 | Card title shown in the chat.
tool wechat_send_share.url | string, required, min length 1, max length 8192 | Link the card opens.
